initial_instruction: Review the fundamental/root parts of the desktop app performance issue.
result_summary: Identified the remaining root bottleneck as a 14k-line MonitorShell monolith with weak section/code boundaries, split Tool Studio into a top-level Next dynamic chunk, added idle module preload, updated tests, measured performance, and completed internal Tauri packaging.
verification: chunk inspection: Tool Studio strings moved to separate chunks 0cbtc.g2b83vn.js and 09yq_9dx5v2xh.js
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app/renderer/workspace-monitor run perf:sections -- http://127.0.0.1:3351/#section-overview: passed, average 458ms, p95 667.7ms, max resident/mounted 5
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app/renderer/workspace-monitor run perf:budget: passed, largest chunk 734386 bytes, chunkCount 22
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app test: passed, 22 tests
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app run check: passed
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app run package:internal: passed, app and dmg built and verified
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app/renderer/workspace-monitor run collect -- --best-effort: developer snapshot restored
corepack pnpm --dir platform-desktop-app/renderer/workspace-monitor run check: passed after snapshot restore
grounding_checks: Local code structure, chunk inspection, tests, performance audit, build, and package verification were used as primary evidence.
Performance interpretation records both improvement and tradeoff: average improved from 482ms to 458ms; p95 worsened from 652.7ms to 667.7ms.
deferred_improvement_targets: Extract DesktopRuntimePanel from MonitorShell into a dynamic workbench module.
Split Agents detail panels into active-detail dynamic boundaries.
Add repeated-run performance reporting to reduce single-run variance.
improvement_ideas: Extract DesktopRuntimePanel next because it is the largest remaining Shell-local panel.
Create a bundle contract that fails when a tab panel remains statically imported into MonitorShell.
Track main-thread long tasks during audits, not only section settle time.
